featured.title: Swyx · Latent Space 主理人、smol.ai / Cognition 联创
featured.summaryEn: Swyx (host of Latent Space, co-founder of smol.ai and Cognition) offered a sharp read on today's hiring market: it's a huge bull market for AI-native ICs and player-coaches, and a huge bear market for "head of X" managers. He says he's never seen such furious bifurcation, distilling it to one line—"1 year experience managing 10 agents beats 10 years experience managing 10-100 people." He noted he's just reporting the trend and there are plenty of counterexamples.
featured.insightZh: Swyx（Latent Space 播客主理人、smol.ai 与 Cognition 联合创始人）这周甩出一个关于当下招聘市场的犀利判断：现在是 AI 原生个人贡献者（IC）和「球员兼教练」型人才的超级牛市，却是「某某负责人」这类纯管理岗的超级熊市。他说自己从没见过如此剧烈的两极分化，用一句话把趋势说透了——「管理 10 个 agent 的 1 年经验，胜过管理 10 到 100 个人的 10 年经验」。他也补充这只是在陈述观察，反例很多，不必对号入座。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI's Codex & ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux did two things this week. First, a candid post-mortem on GPT-5.6 Sol usage: he reset limits for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users and admitted Sol was draining limits faster than expected—because it's more willing to work longer, make more tool calls, and coordinate complex workflows across tools and subagents, working "harder at the same reasoning effort" than prior models, with code mode inflating parallel calls and cached tokens. After fixes, typical usage should l…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 这周做了两件事。一是就 GPT-5.6 Sol 的用量问题坦诚复盘：他重置了所有 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户的用量限制，并承认 Sol 比预期更快耗尽额度——原因是 Sol 更愿意长时间工作、发起更多工具调用、跨工具和子 agent 协同复杂流程，同样的推理强度下比前代模型「更卖力」，加上 code mode（程序化工具调用）让并行调用和缓存 token 激增。改进后预计典型场景下用量能多撑约 18%，第二天恢复此前暂停的五小时限制。他直言「我们本该更早意识到这点、也更坦率一些」。二是开源了一套 CLI 和 TypeScript SDK，用于扫描代码仓库、发现、验证并修复安全漏洞，可接入 CI 做安全检查。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者、前 Roblox 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang demonstrated a full "rough idea to useful product" workflow with a real build. Tired of rating movies on IMDb while Letterboxd doesn't support video games, he built Tastemaker using Claude Design and Claude Code—a single beautiful profile for your favorite movies, TV shows, and games. He recorded a video walking through his full process: writing a design.md and HTML spec, prototyping screens in Claude Design, then building and iterating with Claude Code. Due to API limits, it launch…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 这周用一个真实项目演示了「从粗糙想法到可用产品」的全流程。他厌倦了用 IMDb 给影视打分、而 Letterboxd 又不支持电子游戏，于是用 Claude Design 和 Claude Code 做了一个叫 Tastemaker 的产品，让人把喜欢的电影、剧集和游戏都收进一个漂亮的个人主页。他还录了一段视频完整走查自己的工作流：先写 design.md 和 HTML 规格，再在 Claude Design 里做屏幕原型，最后用 Claude Code 构建和迭代。因 API 限制首发只开放前 100 个名额。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper shared a vivid example of AI reshaping creative work: he spent a morning on his couch writing "the definitive history of Codex," without his hands touching the keyboard or mouse once. The piece draws on hours of in-depth interviews with the Codex team (including Thibault Sottiaux, Anthony Ambrosino, and Greg Brockman), with organizing interviews, building a timeline, writing, editing, and revising all done through ChatGPT for Work's voice mode. He called it "absolutely goated for creative wor…
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 分享了一个关于 AI 改变创作方式的鲜活样本：他花了一上午在沙发上写「Codex 的权威历史」，全程双手没碰过一次键盘或鼠标。这篇文章基于对 Codex 团队（包括 Thibault Sottiaux、Anthony Ambrosino、Greg Brockman）数小时的深度访谈，而组织访谈、搭时间线、写作、编辑、修订全部通过 ChatGPT for Work 的语音模式完成。他给这套用于创意工作的流程打了满分——「absolutely goated」，完整文章将在几周后发布于 Every。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad floated a striking thought experiment: imagine SETI@Home—where you donated compute to search for aliens—but instead you donate compute to search for math proofs. The tweet extends his ongoing interest in distributed computing and AI frontier problems, repointing the "crowdsourced compute cracking hard science" paradigm toward automated mathematical proofs.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 抛出一个很有画面感的设想：想象一下 SETI@Home——那个你曾把闲置算力捐出去搜寻外星人的项目——只不过这次你捐出算力去搜索数学证明。这条推文延续了他一贯对分布式计算和 AI 前沿命题的兴趣，把「众包算力攻克硬核科学问题」这个老范式指向了自动化数学证明这个新方向。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons GP、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: South Park Commons GP, former Dropbox CTO, and early Facebook engineer Aditya Agarwal shared a personal insight from a decade ago. Going through his own "Minus One" journey, lost in the fog of uncertainty, he distilled two deep realizations: one, he wants to build new things in the world; two, he wants to work with brilliant and intense people. He says on days like this, both feel abundant—a plain, earnest reflection on founder intention and how to choose the people you build with.
items.insightZh: South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO、Facebook 早期工程师 Aditya Agarwal 分享了一段十年前的个人顿悟。当年他正经历自己的「Minus One」旅程、迷失在不确定性的迷雾里，最终提炼出两条深刻的自我认知：一是他想在世界上创造新东西，二是他想和才华横溢、充满强度的人共事。他说在如今这样的日子里，这两样都无比充盈。这是一条关于创业者初心和择人标准的朴素而真诚的自省。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监、前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人
items.summaryEn: Meta AI Sr Director Madhu Guru, who previously led Gemini, Veo, and Nano Banana at Google, used a joke to capture how thoroughly AI has reshaped an engineer's daily workflow: he said he saw a SWE at work with no Claude, no Wispr, not even hitting the tab key—"just writing code, with his bare hands." The light jab is really a sketch of a reality where AI coding tools have become default infrastructure. Generated through the Follow Builders skill: https://github.com/zarazhangrui/follow-builders
items.insightZh: Meta AI 高级总监、曾在 Google 主导 Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 的 Madhu Guru 用一条玩笑话点破了当下工程师的日常已经被 AI 彻底改造：他说今天在公司看到一个软件工程师，没用 Claude，没用 Wispr，连 Tab 键都不按——「就那么徒手写代码」。轻松的调侃背后，是对 AI 编程工具已成默认基础设施这一现实的侧写。
